title: next.34+ builds fail in consumers: Module parse failed on TypeScript source of node_modules/cyclotron (add to transpilePackages in withPapyrus)
description: Evidence: Threat-Intelligence PR #16 (pin bump to @anthusai/papyrus 1.0.0-next.35, merged e41feb5) -> Amplify app dzefa11i80jyq main job 11 FAILED at BUILD: Module parse failed on TypeScript sources under node_modules/cyclotron/trace-ui/src/ (cyclotron-status.tsx, review-control.tsx, cyclotronStatus.ts), imported by components/newsroom-references-view.tsx and topic-steering-workspace.tsx (Papyrus#168-#170). next.31 had no cyclotron dependency. Planned fix: add cyclotron to default transpilePackages in withPapyrus (src/with-papyrus.mjs), regression test, verify-packages check, prove with real consumer build. Live TI deployment remains job 10 (next.31).
